'''Sorno''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] in the service of [[Karagga]] the Hutt during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He served as a bodyguard in [[Karagga's Palace]] where he was partnered with the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] mercenary [[Jarg (mercenary)|Jarg]]. When a strike team [[Battle of Karagga's Palace|attacked]] the palace, Jarg and Sorno confronted them in the audience chamber. Though adept in combat, Sorno was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Sorno, in conjunction with Jarg, serves as the second boss of ''Operation: Karagga's Palace'' in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. This article assumes 100% game completion, so he was killed.
